context.body: Sacred place and divine name do not shield conduct that contradicts the covenant.

observations.body: The LORD commands amended ways, condemns oppression and idolatry, and warns that the house bearing the divine name can be treated like Shiloh.
observations.label: God rejects confidence in the temple: action

observations.body: Worshipers repeat “the LORD’s temple” while committing injustice and trusting the building.

payload.posture: Read Jeremiah 7:1–15 as the prophetic voice evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The warning attacks false security, not the claim that the temple ever mattered.
